work.title: Untitled (CDs and Hearts) 2
work.description: Sparse collage on ivory paper combines ink drawings, compact discs, and photographic fragments across a large open ground. Hand-drawn hearts, concentric circles, and dotted lines are distributed loosely, with red iridescent material and two CDs anchoring the right side.
work.composition: scattered elements across open ivory ground
keywords: sparse ink drawing with compact discs
